title: funastrum pavonii
intro: Funastrum pavonii, commonly known as Mexican Devil's Claw, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to Mexico. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce swelling. Its therapeutic actions include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Funastrum pavonii include alkaloids, such as pavonin B and pavonin C, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
